subject: How can I add subsets of my data to the same plot ?? (ggplot in R)

messages.author: f1efb2722cc565d2
messages.subject: How can I add subsets of my data to the same plot ?? (ggplot in R)
parts:
Hi all!


I am trying to replicate by ggplot what I did in Plotly (Orca utility never worked...).


In my dataset, "strain" column has data for "w" and "mut1".


First, I generated a plot only with "w" (saved as "g"), then I added the "mut1" to the plot (Plotly) by using:


g <- g %>% add_trace(data = data[which(data$strain == 'mut1'),]

Question: What is the equivalent way to do exactly the same (to add the mut1 to the graph containing w) with ggplot?


These ones did not work:

(g %>% geom_line(data = data[which(data$strain == 'mut1'),]

g + geom_line(data = data[which(data$strain == 'mut1'),])


Thank you very much in advance!!
